meta.why_not_alibaba: Alibaba.com answers an automated browser with a slider verification (bot check, see the sunglasses file). It was not bypassed; Made-in-China.com lists the same kind of China factory prices.
meta.price_meaning: FOB-style factory price per pair (shoes) or per piece (golf tees) in USD as listed, a range from the largest tier to the MOQ tier. Not shipping, duty, mold, logo, packaging or the package of 50 tees.
meta.note: Only the first two listings of a supplier are written down per page (the script keeps two per supplier anyway). The pages are the first page of the search; the listing order is the site's own ('hot products').
